title: Why Some Women Cross the Finish Line Ahead of Men

sentences.en: A Women who apply for jobs in middle or senior management have a higher success rate than men, according to an employment survey.
sentences.zh: 根据就业调查,申请中高级管理职位的妇女的成功率高于男子。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: But of course far fewer of them apply for these positions.
sentences.zh: 但当然,申请这些职位的人要少得多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The study, by recruitment consultants NB Selection, shows that while one in six men who appear on interview shortlists get jobs, the figure rises to one in four for women.
sentences.zh: 这项研究通过征聘顾问 " 国家抽样 " 的甄选,表明在面试短名单中出现的每6名男子中就有一名得到工作,而妇女这一数字则上升到每4名妇女中就有1人得到工作。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

words.def: 咨询人咨询人咨询人咨询人

sentences.en: B The study concentrated on applications for management positions in the $45,000 to $110,000 salary range and found that women are more successful than men in both the private and public sectors Dr Elisabeth Marx from London-based NB Selection described the findings as encouraging for women, in that they send a positive message to them to apply for interesting management positions.
sentences.zh: B. 这项研究集中于45 000美元至110 000美元薪金范围内的管理职位申请,发现在私营和公共部门,妇女比男子更成功。 伦敦国家银行甄选的Elisabeth Marx博士认为,研究结果对妇女令人鼓舞,因为她们向她们发出了积极的信息,要求她们申请有趣的管理职位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But she added, “We should not lose sight of the fact that significantly fewer women apply for senior positions in comparison with men.”
sentences.zh: 但她补充说,“我们不应忽视这样一个事实,即申请高级职位的妇女比男子少得多。”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C Reasons for higher success rates among women are difficult to isolate.
sentences.zh: 妇女成功率较高的原因难以孤立。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One explanation suggested is that if a woman candidate manages to get on a shortlist, then she has probably already proved herself to be an exceptional candidate.
sentences.zh: 提出的一个解释是,如果一名女性候选人设法被列入入围名单,那么她可能已经证明自己是例外的候选人。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Dr Marx said that when women apply for positions they tend to be better qualified than their male counterparts but are more selective and conservative in their job search.
sentences.zh: Marx博士说,当妇女申请职位时,她们往往比男性同行更有资格,但在求职时则更有选择性和保守。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Women tend to research thoroughly before applying for positions or attending interviews.
sentences.zh: 妇女往往在申请职位或参加面试之前先进行彻底研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Men, on the other hand, seem to rely on their ability to sell themselves and to convince employers that any shortcomings they have will not prevent them from doing a good job.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,男子似乎依赖他们出卖自己的能力,并说服雇主,他们的任何缺点不会妨碍他们做好工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D Managerial and executive progress made by women is confirmed by the annual survey of boards of directors carried out by Korn/ Ferry/ Carre/ Orban International.
sentences.zh: Korn/Ferry/Carre/Orban International公司对董事会进行的年度调查证实了妇女的管理和行政进展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This year the survey shows a doubling of the number of women serving as non-executive directors compared with the previous year.
sentences.zh: 今年的调查显示,与前一年相比,担任非执行董事的妇女人数增加了一倍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, progress remains painfully slow and there were still only 18 posts filled by women out of a total of 354 nonexecutive positions surveyed.
sentences.zh: 然而,进展仍然缓慢,令人痛苦,在总共354个非执行职务中,仍然只有18个由妇女担任。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Hilary Sears, a partner with Korn/ Ferry, said, “Women have raised the level of grades we are employed in but we have still not broken through barriers to the top.”
sentences.zh: 与Korn/Ferry的合作伙伴Hilary Sears说,“妇女提高了我们受雇的等级,但我们仍未突破顶部的障碍。”

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E In Europe a recent feature of corporate life in the recession has been the delayering of management structures.
sentences.zh: E 在欧洲,衰退中公司生活的一个近期特点是管理结构的拖延。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Sears said that this has halted progress for women in as much as de-layering has taken place either where women are working or in layers they aspire to.
sentences.zh: 海员说,这已经阻止了妇女在妇女工作或她们希望从事的层次上实现的取消权利等方面的进展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Sears also noted a positive trend from the recession, which has been the growing number of women who have started up on their own.
sentences.zh: 西尔斯还注意到经济衰退的积极趋势,即越来越多的妇女自行开始创业。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: F In business as a whole, there are a number of factors encouraging the prospect of greater equality in the workforce.
sentences.zh: 在整个商业中,有一系列因素鼓励提高劳动力平等的前景。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Demographic trends suggest that the number of women going into employment is steadily increasing.
sentences.zh: 人口趋势表明,就业妇女的人数在稳步增加。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In addition a far greater number of women are now passing through higher education, making them better qualified to move into management positions.
sentences.zh: 此外,现在通过高等教育的妇女人数要多得多,使她们更有资格担任管理职务。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G Organisations such as the European Women’s Management Development Network provide a range of opportunities for women to enhance their skills and contacts.
sentences.zh: G. 欧洲妇女管理发展网络等组织为妇女提供一系列机会,提高妇女的技能和接触。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Through a series of both pan-European and national workshops and conferences the barriers to women in employment are being broken down.
sentences.zh: 通过一系列泛欧和全国性讲习班和会议,正在打破妇女就业的障碍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, Ariane Berthoin Antal, director of the International Institute for Organisational Change of Archamps in France, said that there is only anecdotal evidence of changes in recruitment patterns.
sentences.zh: 然而,法国Archamps组织变革国际研究所所长Ariane Berthoin Atal说,只有传闻证据表明征聘模式发生变化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And she said, “It’s still so hard for women to even get on to shortlists -there are so many hurdles and barriers.”
sentences.zh: 女性甚至连入入围名单都很难, 障碍和障碍也很多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Antal agreed that there have been some positive signs but said “Until there is a belief among employers, until they value the difference, nothing will change.”
sentences.zh: Antal同意,有一些积极的迹象,但说,“除非雇主之间有信仰,除非他们重视差异,否则一切都不会改变。”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。
